evidence.quote: Microstructure control and DRX characteristics of Ni–Co–W superalloys affected by changing deformation direction on [001] columnar grain
In this study, the effect of compression direction on DRX behaviors in microstructure evolution of a Ni–Co–W superalloy during hot deformation at 1140 ◦C with various true strain was analyzed.
